ci.triggers: PR opened/synchronize/reopened/ready_for_review/labeled/edited targeting deploy branch; nightly 04:17 UTC; dispatch group/renderer_macos/gl; reusable call before_sha/concurrency_key/fast_tier_run. Header supplemental scope listed.
ci.permissions: default contents:read; select and driving-model explicitly add actions:read; train-twins contents:read
ci.concurrency: workflow ci-{caller key|noise run key|schedule/dispatch run ID|PR head ref|ref}; cancel only PR; selected PR legs selected-lane-{matrix.lane} queue:max, other legs unique per run/index

jobs.driving-model: select -> driving boolean, not Pages/fast-tier reuse; draft reuse script -> characterization traces; always junit telemetry and failure/cancel report
jobs.renderer-macos: select.renderer true plus Pages/nightly/forced dispatch/ready PR; hardware census anyHardware===true -> single-worker gfx; always diagnostic artifact
jobs.xr: select.xr true and no caller key; IWER browser suite; failure/cancel artifact
jobs.train-twins: Pages only, successful select with twins/adapted outputs -> node tests; adapted uses APEX_VM_PAGE=1, circuits propagated
jobs.select: geometry + node slices + cached failures + selected shards + train twin plan + gaps + ship/renderer/XR filters + advisory base verdict
jobs.selected: select.any true, no draft -> dynamic matrix, marker artifact -> browser run -> always junit + failure/cancel diagnostics
jobs.selected-verdict: needs select,selected,guards; not cancelled push/PR/Pages; collects all junit and run markers, gaps fail except warn on train; script judges selected/dropped; persists one merged failure cache
jobs.baseline-trial: nightly/direct dispatch only, no Pages; test:baseline then always 14-day diagnostic upload; job name/prose says nonblocking but executable job/step lacks continue-on-error on test so failure remains blocking via ci-verdict
jobs.staged-boot: full-tier stage/minify/stamp -> assert SHA -> dedicated _site server -> smoke; no ship filter; failure/cancel report
jobs.ci-verdict: needs every preceding major job including baseline-trial; !cancelled; evaluated alternate names for noise/draft; NEEDS JSON + strict REQUIRE_SUCCESS on ready PR -> ci-verdict.mjs

ci.consumers: Pages reusable gate and required CI check; timing workflow consumes junit artifact prefixes; selected-verdict consumes selected junit/marker prefixes and select outputs; next select restores merged failed-spec cache
ci.cleanup: No PR comment producer/cleanup in assigned CI span; artifact retention 7d except baseline 14d; merged failure cache written once per run

desktop.triggers: ready non-draft packaging-path PR; dispatch signed_verify=true; desktop-v* tags
desktop.concurrency: per workflow/head ref or ref; cancel-in-progress:true
desktop.inputs: signed_verify declared but unused by step conditions; CSC_LINK presence controls optional verification
desktop.outputs: pack-smoke 7d desktop-pw OS/run artifacts; release OS installers+metadata 14d; update plan job summary
desktop.contracts: desktop npm ci; pack:test enables inspect fuse and asserts it; _electron soft GL with Linux xvfb; release dist:linux/win/mac; no publish/release action

flake_tally.triggers: 06:19 daily, minute17 every2h base-red; dispatch days/mode
flake_tally.graph: single tally on deploy branch, Node22, no npm install
flake_tally.io: failed ci/pages runs+failed browser logs -> proposals and one marked flaky issue; base-red reads 3h and creates/refreshes/closes marked issue
flake_tally.cleanup: updates issue body/title; no comment producer/deletion; base-red closes clean-window issue; daily upsert does not close clean issue or remove duplicate issues; never edits quarantine

garage_before.triggers: 10:23 daily or dispatch ref (deploy branch default)
garage_before.concurrency: workflow per requested ref noncancelling; capture max-parallel2 no concurrency group; pack per SHA noncancelling
garage_before.graph: plan outputs capture/SHA/reason/matrix/views -> conditional macOS capture -> successful capture required pack
garage_before.io: four team shards x seven views; exact resolved SHA captured; shard prefix retained5d -> merge and MANIFEST -> SHA pack retained30d; fetch script consumes final pack
garage_before.cleanup: artifact expiry only, no comment producer; advisory non-gate

gpu_census_partial.triggers: 05:47 nightly, dispatch, request-file push on cursor/** or claude/**
gpu_census_partial.concurrency: push ref+runID; nightly separate and cancelling; dispatch per-ref noncancelling (single pending replacement applies)
gpu_census_partial.graph: plan gate+normalize outputs -> image census matrix unless run=false; no later jobs within assigned span
gpu_census_partial.gate: topic pushes require own nonmerge first-parent request edit; ship push runs; nightly compares last green nightly renderer paths, unknown runs; dispatch always runs
gpu_census_partial.normalization: runner allowlist/fallback macOS; newline flatten strings; clock0..23; TOD enum; mem_cycles0..16; cam/entry enums; request-only experiment switches; LRM rows/leg/scale clamps
gpu_census_partial.io: adapter census JSON+job summary; ordinary native-present three/WebGPU and three/WebGL2 JSON/PNG; GLX command only partial; relaunch persistent profile and fixed origin; opt-in memcycles and request experiments upload artifacts with7/14d retention
gpu_census_partial.limits: Game checks continue-on-error and capped6m; final verdict/upload outside assigned span; do not infer workflow success from measurement-step outcome
